camel_example: aliyun ddoscoo ModifyBlockStatus --region cn-hangzhou --Status do --InstanceId 'ddoscoo-cn-mp91j1ao0000' --Lines.1 ct
description_en: Modifies the Diversion from Origin Server configuration of an Anti-DDoS Proxy (Chinese Mainland) instance
description_zh: 设置DDoS高防（中国内地）实例的近源流量压制
kebab_example: aliyun ddoscoo modify-block-status --status do --instance-id ddoscoo-cn-mp91j1ao0000 --lines ct --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyBlockStatus

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the status of the Diversion from Origin Server policy. Valid values:

do: enables the policy.
undo: disables the policy
parameters.help_zh:
设置近源流量压制的状态。取值：

do：表示开启近源流量压制。
undo：表示关闭近源流量压制
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The blocking period. Valid values: 15 to 43200. Unit: minutes.

If you set Status to do, you must also specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
要封禁的时长。取值范围：15~43200，单位：分钟。

Status为do（表示开启近源流量压制）时，该参数必选
parameters.name: duration

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Anti-DDoS Proxy (Chinese Mainland) instance to manage.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157459.html operation to query the IDs of all Anti-DDoS Proxy instances
parameters.help_zh:
要操作的DDoS高防（中国内地）实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157459.html查询所有DDoS高防实例的ID信息
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: An array consisting of the Internet service provider (ISP) lines from which traffic is blocked
parameters.name: lines
